gpio_api.h

GPIO interface declarations for the SoC FPGA bare-metal stack.

These declarations require alignment with gpio_api.c in this revision.  See api/gpio/README.md for the implemented call flow before integration.

Types
gpio_handle_t

Opaque GPIO handle type used to preserve module state between calls.

gpio_status_t

Status values declared by this interface.

Values
GPIO_OK

Success status.

GPIO_ERROR

Generic error status.

gpio_pin_id_t

Numeric GPIO pin identifier.

gpio_direction_t

Input and output pin directions.

Values
GPIO_INPUT

Configure as an input.

GPIO_OUTPUT

Configure as an output.

gpio_ioctl_cmd_t

Control command selectors declared by this interface.

Values
GPIO_CMD_SET_DIRECTION

Set pin direction.

GPIO_CMD_SET_INTERRUPT

Set interrupt configuration.

gpio_callback_fn
typedef void (
*
gpio_callback_fn
)(void *param)

Callback signature used by the GPIO module.

Parameters
param

Caller context supplied during callback registration.
